description: This file defines the 'SeriesCollectionMapper' class responsible for mapping chart series data from a document object model to a PDFSharp chart series collection. It contains methods for translating object properties and nested elements like points, colors, and styles.

classes.name: SeriesCollectionMapper
classes.description: Mapper class for converting series collections from document object model to PDFSharp chart series collections.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps a MigraDoc SeriesCollection to a PDFSharp SeriesCollection, copying properties and nested points.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method that creates a new mapper instance and invokes MapObject to perform the mapping.
